ReportExecEvent reports a blocked or audited process execution.

 Use this method to:
 - Report process executions that were blocked or audited by security policy

 ### Examples

 - Report a blocked execution:

   ```yaml
   environmentId: "d2c94c27-3b76-4a42-b88c-95a85e392c68"
   executable: "sha256:a1b2c3d4..."
   filename: "/usr/bin/curl"
   action: KERNEL_CONTROLS_ACTION_BLOCK
   process:
     pid: 1234
     tid: 1234
     name: "curl"
     cmdline: "curl https://example.com"
     startedAt:
